narration: This is the plugin's sample application: a catalogue, a cart and an order. Small enough to read end to end, real enough to be worth filming.
The red box is drawn by the walkthrough, not by the application. It lets the narration point at something, so the viewer knows exactly where to look.
We add two products and the total updates: thirteen thousand seven hundred. The same box, now around the total, because that is what this line is about.
We fill in the customer's name. So far this is a person using the application, and every step has been photographed.
An API call has nothing to photograph. The plugin draws it as a card: what was sent, what the server answered, and the note saying three more fields were deliberately left off screen.
And the order confirmed on screen. This walkthrough is an end-to-end test: when the screen changes it will break, and the video will not go stale in silence.
